announcements.title: Fall 2026 class routine published (V1)
announcements.body: The official Class Routine Fall 2026 V1 for Batch 29 – Batch 36 is now live (shared with the department Google Sheet). Routine is generated per batch, section and laboratory group; off days are per the Batch Day Off tab.
announcements.created_by_name: Office of the Head, Dept. of Pharmacy

announcements.title: Laboratory classes run in groups (A1 / A2 / B1 / B2)
announcements.body: All laboratory classes follow the official group rotation — students see only their own group’s lab sessions in the portal. Each lab session is 1 hour 30 minutes in the lab rooms AB-1 602, AB-1 603, AB-1 605, AB-1 606, AB-1 702, AB-1 703, AB-1 704 and AB-1 706.

announcements.title: Guest lecture: Pharmacovigilance in Bangladesh
announcements.body: A guest lecture on "Pharmacovigilance in Bangladesh" by Prof. Dr. Muniruddin Ahamed will be held for Batch 29 in Classroom AB-1 504. Attendance is mandatory.

announcements.title: Mid-term examination schedule (Batch 29–33)
announcements.body: Mid-term examinations for Batch 29 – Batch 33 will commence from the third week of Fall 2026. Detailed exam routine will be published on the department notice board.

announcements.title: Rooms AB-1 103 & AB-1 504 — other departments
announcements.body: Per the official routine, Classroom AB-1 103 is reserved for the Agriculture Dept and Classroom AB-1 504 is used by the NFE Dept (Sun–Thu). Pharmacy students should report to their scheduled rooms; these two rooms are not Pharmacy teaching rooms.
